name: Certificate Watch
description: TLS certificate expiry monitoring: scans the certificates your services actually present, raises incidents as they age, and includes renewal guidance.

settings.label: Endpoints to watch
settings.help: host:port entries, comma or newline separated. The plugin connects and reads the certificate the service actually presents - no file access or privileges needed.

settings.label: Renewal hint
settings.placeholder: sudo certbot renew && sudo systemctl reload nginx
settings.help: Shown with every expiry incident. For Let's Encrypt certs a certbot command is added automatically.
